items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: And next to Eddie is his brother Irving, Irvin Dusan, who's currently president of Columbia Homestead, who gave up music many years back.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, in the old days, it was a Jung Hotel.

And the Jung Hotel had a beautiful roof garden up there where they held a lot of dances up on a Jung roof. They also had a beautiful room down on the bottom called the Florentine Room on the main floor. But a lot of the dances were held up on a Jung roof in the old days back in the 30s and late 20s and early 30s and late 30s for that matter. And this shot, a photograph I shot up on a Jung roof. And it shows Al Streaming standing up and Leon Fellman on drums and Leon Krasnoff on saxophone. I can't remember two of…
May I look at it? Mm-hmm. Say that you're not in the picture because you took it.
